title: Self-supervised learning
reading: A brief content slide listing the two families of modern self-supervised learning methods: contrastive learning and predictive learning. Both are named as bullet items without further elaboration on this page, suggesting they are unpacked in subsequent slides.

concepts.name: Self-supervised learning
concepts.why_it_matters: Framing topic: learning representations from unlabelled data.

concepts.name: Contrastive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: One of the two major modern SSL paradigms introduced here.

concepts.name: Predictive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: The complementary SSL paradigm to contrastive methods.
